correctness.rationale: The derived ideal equals span(e3,...,en), and for n>=4 its centralizer equals the intrinsic abelian hyperplane span(e2,...,en); this forces the first two automorphism columns. The recursive bracket fixes all other columns, and every choice with a,d nonzero preserves all brackets and is invertible, in every characteristic. The diagonal a,d,ad,...,a^(n-2)d yields the fixed-point condition. Cyclicity of finite-field units and Euler totients give the exact count. The nonemptiness criterion follows by considering a primitive unit when q>n, and proper nontrivial divisors of q-1 otherwise. All 13 standalone independent checks passed; five configurations exhaust all automorphisms over the tested field.

value.rationale: A single complete formula determines a natural automorphism-group fixed-space statistic for every finite field and every dimension at least four. It reveals a sharp arithmetic field-size/dimension phase transition: q-1 composite ensures existence in all dimensions while q-1 prime forces extinction at dimension q. This distinguishes finite fields with similar sizes and refines the earlier complex-field existence theorem rather than producing a routine individual table entry.
